name: fractal-planner
description: Iterative planning and execution framework for Claude Code with fractal task decomposition and builder/verifier agent teams
author: Your Name <your.email@example.com>

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && find src skills -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.d.ts' -o -name '*.js.map' -o -name '*.d.ts.map' \) -delete
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build
